title: Chapter 643
paragraphs: Chapter 643
Episode 164. Land of Evil Spirits (5)
The lightning of the Monarch's Rule Sword was gradually subsiding.
The breath escaping from Jin's mouth was rough. He felt nauseous from the fatigue of continuous battles and the mental shock.
"Brother, are you alright?"
"I'm okay, for now."
He could continue to fight. His condition was not good, but he thought he could still exert his maximum power once more.
Jin and Kaio looked up at the sky at the same time.
As the dark cloud formed by the lightning disappeared, they saw the bottom of Lam once again.

The sight of chaos dragons and black lines pouring out like a swarm of bees leaving a hive, and the landscape of them being shattered by bombardment and turning into wreckage, shook their vision dizzily.
At a glance, it seemed that Runecandel was finally being pushed back... but there was no end.
As if to mock the external evaluation that it was lagging far behind in technological advancement, Lam kept spewing chaos dragons and black lines without rest.
Moreover, Lam was reloading the main cannon again.
The black cannon, which destroyed the second fleet of Zifl in a single blow, was now targeting Kinzelo.
"But... we need to prepare to escape."
Inflict maximum damage while the noble family does not yet accurately know his power, and rescue the resistance members.
That's why Jin came to the Garden of Swords alone today, and he expected that the former was somewhat accomplished.
'The knights killed today will resurrect soon, and the summoned knights like Lionel or Sir Paddler will reappear... but there will definitely be constraints. A significant price will be required.'
Recalton.
The land expected to be the place where they gather humans, the material needed to clone Joshua's body.
It would require at least hundreds, if not thousands, of humans just to create his clone.
There was no need to mention figures like Paddler or Lionel.
'The escape of the resistance members is up to the elders' abilities and luck.'
He wanted to follow and protect them right now if he could, but that would only put them in danger.
There were no more new energies appearing from the direction of Youngmyo.
Intuitively, Jin felt that Rosa would now come looking for him.
He could see the chaos that had wrapped around the Garden of Swords was again converging into one place. To the center of the black line, probably where Rosa was standing.
As it stands, there's no chance of winning a contest against her.
As expected, the maximum power of Kinzelo and Zifl all came, and he himself dealt with the Black Knight Captain, the summoned ancestral head of the house, and the Ten Knights.
Yet Runecandel is standing unflinchingly.
"You've thought well. I think it's better to plan for the future. To overthrow the owner of this land, you will need the help of your brothers."
"The same goes for our escape right now. Protect us, Brother Kaio."
At Jin's heavy voice, Kaio snorted.
"Ha, you seem sorry to use me as a shield. Get rid of such thoughts, death in a summoned state isn't real."
Kaio was already convinced. He said that his sacrifice would be necessary for Jin to leave this place.
Jin's gaze reached Youngmyo.
Before starting to escape, he wanted to hit Youngmyo one last time, but some of the chaos converging on Lam's center was forming a barrier near Youngmyo.
"They are clearly guarding against any problems arising in Youngmyo......"
"I was just about to say that we should hit that place before leaving, but I guess it's better to just leave. Brother."
Without a doubt, it seemed that a sword at least equivalent to the Upwha or the Monarch's Rule Sword would be needed to penetrate the barrier of chaos. Or deploy a spirit sword ultimate skill.
If he did that, escape would be impossible.
"It's not too bad since we have confirmed that Youngmyo is a very important tool and weakness."
Jin turned his body.
The place where Talalris was located was a forest about 300 ri away from the Garden of Swords. After breaking through there, they had to move to the area where the Red Owl was hidden by riding Mote.
"Shuri."
[Meow!]
The two mounted on Shuri, who had just escaped from the red jade.
Far away, the knights of chaos, who started gathering again like beetles, could be seen.
However, no matter how many of them there are, they are not much of a threat. It just wastes a bit of stamina.
"Let's go, to Lord Talalris."
Following the trajectory of Shuri running at full speed, the knights of chaos started to explode en masse.
And not long after the escape began, Jin and Kaio were able to realize one fact.
"I was a bit curious about this, but aren't they also your enemies, brother?"
Kaio pointed to the back with his chin.
The fleet of Kinzelo, they have been providing ground support fire from the time when the two were fighting with Paddler.
Support continued to the extent that there was no need for Kaio to protect Jin.
The chaos dragons descending to capture Jin all oxidized in the air without reaching Shuri, and all the black line's bombardments were intercepted.

"They are enemies. However, they will likely realize that they need me in the future. Whether it's Zifl or Kinzelo, they would have determined that they couldn't possibly conquer the Garden of Swords on their own."
If they can't call back the Monarch's siblings as hostages. The same was true for Jin.
No, he even thought that a temporary alliance with the enemies might be needed even if he could call the siblings.
Now, Runecandel is not just one giant force.....
Glyiek.
It was like a colossal disaster that had enveloped the entire world.
"Well, they aren't completely stupid, I suppose."
He killed the obstructing Chaos Knights and broke through the front gate. The endless black landscape of chaos continued before him.
Even when they reached the vicinity of the center of Calon, the scene did not change. Only then did Jin realize that not only the Garden of Swords but the entire Calon had been consumed by chaos.
It wasn't entirely unexpected. To use such chaos, a clear ingredient was needed.
However, it was inevitable to feel stupefied when witnessing it firsthand.
- To me, the survival and prosperity of Runecandle are more important than anything else. Nothing can surpass that value.
- Even if humans die in the billions in the process of achieving it, even if the world perishes in the desolate struggle and fight, and only a few members of Runecandle remain. I do not care.
Suddenly, Rosa's words from the past came to mind.
'Really... Are they ready to erase the whole world, leaving only Runecandle...'
Like a beast opening its mouth, the center of Lam was split in half.
The cannon fired directly at Kinzelo's fleet. A huge hole was punched in the center of Zephyrin, and the overlapping protective shields behind it were bursting.
For the first time, he was relieved to see the enemy hadn't died. Zephyrin, even with a hole in its torso, seemed to breathe without any other damage, its power undiminished.
In response to Kinzelo's counterattack over Zephyrin, for the first time, visible damage spread on Lam's hull.
The left side of the hull was crumbling.
Surely, Lam appeared weaker than before. There was only one thing this fact meant.
The power of Rosa being used in Lam was being recollected. It was not that the total amount of chaos had diminished.
In the midst of a violent war that made it impossible to tell how time was passing.
Before long, Shuri was running 100 Li outside the Garden of Swords. And Jin felt a very faint, chilling sensation.
Talaris, she was also approaching Jin.
In the past, whenever Talaris came to save him, he used to feel a profound sense of relief beyond words.
But now it was the exact opposite.
'No!'
The fact that the cold was already reaching this far meant that Talaris had already entered the battle, and she was not in a state to exert her full strength now.
And the land soaked in chaos was all Rosa's territory. He had a dreadful hunch that Rosa could not fail to notice Talaris's movements.
'Rosa Runecandle will surely try to deal with Lady Talaris before me...!'
It was unclear how strong Rosa, who had accepted chaos, had become.
But even before the Garden of Swords turned into this state, Rosa was one of the strongest in the world.
Talaris, in her current state, can't handle her.
[Meow!]
Shuri, sensing Jin's anxiety, tried to increase her speed, but it was already at its limit.
“Damn it, Lady Talaris...!”
If something happens to her, he won't be able to face Siris, his other comrades. There would be no way to repay the favor he had received from the non-stop actions till now.
This thought was driving Jin crazy.
"Calm your excitement, Brother Jin."
Kaio, looking at the sky, spoke.
He had been observing the bombardment from the fleets of each force that had been supporting only Jin and himself, heading towards a distant point.
Kinzelo and Zifl had also spotted Talaris and started supporting fire.
"The owner of the chill, she must be someone precious to you, brother. Should we protect her?"
"Is that possible, from this distance?"
Kaio raised his God-killing Bow.

"You seem to have forgotten my specialty. I am the only Fight King who can fight covering you guys. For long-range support, perhaps I might be better than the Fight God brothers. Concentrate as you need to fend off the small fries."
"Understood...!"
Whoosh!
The arrow of the God-killing Bow was being shot into the sky. The shining lightning bolt was flying a distance of fifty Li, creating a pillar of light.
With every shot, cold sweat dripped down Kaio's entire body like rain. Blood was flowing from between his clenched teeth, and his heart throbbed as if it would explode at any moment.
Jin didn't ask Kaio how things were progressing.
The fact that the chill hadn't subsided was certain.
It was just precarious. It was just faint, as if it could go out at any time.
Finally, when they reached the light pillar formed by the God-killing Bow,
Jin was able to face Talaris, who was gasping for breath, soaked in blood.
As soon as he saw her, he felt his heart drop.
But the blood was not Talaris's.
It was the blood of Mot, the frog-eyed. Mot had been protecting Talaris all along, making short dimensional movements in Rosa's chaos.
Without the support fire from Kaio and the fleet, even that would have been impossible. Mot's white body was soaked in blood.
"Jin!"
"Lady Talaris!"
He wanted to approach her immediately, but he saw a single black blade tearing the light pillar in front of Talaris.
It was Rosa Runecandle's sword, soaked in madness and chaos.
[You're here?]
Rosa greeted Jin with a smirk. Jin was drawing Bradamante.
